description: Resolve an ambiguous company or crypto name/ticker to ranked candidates with verified canonical IDs (SEC CIK + ticker, GLEIF LEI, ISIN, Wikidata QID, CoinGecko slug). Each ID is fetched live from its own official registry, so use this instead of recalling an ID from memory. Non-US companies work too: a name with no SEC filing still returns an LEI and ISIN. Production endpoint of entityresolver.xyz — pays $0.005 USDC on Base per call via x402 from BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY. No account or API key needed.
name: resolve_entity
title: Resolve entity (production, $0.005 USDC)
